chunks: Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb narrated from ʿUmar ibn Abān, from Udaym the brother of Ayyūb, from Ḥumrān who said:

I said to Abā ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him): 'They say: Do not be impressed by the group which claims that Allah will remove some people from the Fire and place them among the inhabitants of Paradise with His friends.'

So he said: 'Do they not read the verse in which Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, says: There are two other Gardens below these two (Q55:62)? It refers to a paradise besides Paradise and a fire besides the Fire. They will not dwell with the friends of Allah.'

And he said: 'There is, by Allah, a level [or two levels] between them, but I cannot talk about it [here]. Their matter is more constricted than a [tight] noose. Indeed, were the Riser to rise, he would start with these people.'

key_terms.جَنَّةٌ دُونَ جَنَّةٍ: A paradise distinct from the highest Paradise
key_terms.نَارٌ دُونَ نَارٍ: A fire distinct from the deepest Hell

ai.seo_question: What is the Quranic basis for people exiting Hell to enter Paradise with the friends of God?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) validates the concept of intercession by interpreting 'gardens below gardens' (55:62) as a distinct, intermediate realm for those exiting Hell, clarifying they do not fully merge with the ultimate companions of Allah. This hadith highlights the Shia doctrine of *Afw* (pardon) and the hierarchical nature of Paradise, where the Mahdi (AS) will initiate the judgment process by addressing these specific groups first.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 2.Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb narrated from ʿUmar ibn Abān, from Udaym the brother of Ayyūb, from Ḥumrān who said, “

I said to Abā ʿAbdillāh (a), ‘They say: do not be impressed by the group which claims that Allah will remove some people from the Fire and place them among the inhabitants of Paradise with His friends.’

So he said, ‘Do they not read the verse in which Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, says: There are two other Gardens below these two (Q55:62)? It refers to a paradise besides Paradise and a fire besides the Fire. They will not dwell with the friends of Allah [but rather, in another paradise].’

And he said, ‘There is, by Allah, a level [or two levels] between them, but I cannot talk about it [here]. Their matter is more constricted than a [tight] noose. Indeed, were the Riser to rise, he would start with these people.’”
